milestones.outcome: Core SHA-256 uses deterministic platform crypto under the owner-authorized architecture, with HACL portable fallback and explicit native evidence limits.
exit_criteria: BPR-1617 AC1: architecture, RFC amendment and narrow boundary checks agree.
BPR-1617 AC2: one-shot, streaming, independent copies and failure behavior preserve the public digest contract.
BPR-1617 AC3: macOS native selection and portable HACL verified, with focused composition and gates.
BPR-1617 AC4: CNG contracts verified; native Windows attempted or observed and remaining station obligations retained.
milestones.boundary: One SHA-256 architecture/adoption milestone; no SHA-1, Linux libcrypto, UX or RFC-wide closeout.
